verdict.rationale: Devin ships several built-in event-driven behaviors. Auto-Fix responds automatically to review comments and CI failures, Devin Review runs first-pass reviews on pull requests, and CI/CD pipelines can trigger Devin on static-analysis findings. Scheduling is exposed via MCP, and the API is pitched for automating workflows. However, these are preset toggles or integrations you wire up yourself, not a user-defined rules engine. Missing for 10: a documented way for users to author their own event→action rules (conditions, triggers, actions), documentation of scheduling or trigger configuration, and independent hands-on corroboration.
